svg.title: A grandchild relaying a call to Grandpa
svg.desc: A simple hand-drawn picture. On the left a teenager in a teal T-shirt holds a phone in one hand and cups the other hand at the mouth, turned to the right. On the right a grandfather in a green T-shirt and a cap sits in an armchair with a hand at his ear. The teenager's bubble says "Grandpa, they're wishing you happy birthday.". A label "USB" points to the phone and "RS-232" to the grandfather's ear.
